name: gemini-omni
description: Generate, edit, and extend videos with audio using Google Gemini Omni Flash (gemini-omni-1.1-flash) via the Interactions API. Text-to-video, image-to-video, first/last frame interpolation, subject reference, uploaded-video editing, extension, and multi-turn conversational editing. 16:9 / 9:16, 360p-4k. Works with Gemini Developer API and Vertex AI.
